appDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Web Store.
appDescription.message: Resolve .cyberspace names. Type genesis.cyberspace and it just works.

popupHint.message: Type a .cyberspace name in the address bar and it just works.

optionsBlurb.description: Options-page blurb explaining the bridge endpoint; carries <code> spans, so it is set via innerHTML from this bundled locale string.
optionsBlurb.message: The extension resolves .cyberspace names through this DNS-over-HTTPS bridge. Leave empty to use the genesis bridge (http://185.143.228.228/dns-query). Must be a full http(s) URL with a path. Save (button, blur, or Enter) commits the value — changing it drops the cached health check so the next popup open re-checks live. "Check bridge now" runs a live resolve of genesis.cyberspace against the endpoint currently in the box (unsaved edits included), with no health-cache lookup.

hintNameSpelling.description: Taxonomy hint: the Go path resolve failed on the name itself (spelling or registration).
hintNameSpelling.message: — check the spelling, or claim it on the genesis node

hintNameNoAddress.description: Taxonomy hint: the bridge answered authoritatively but the name carries no address records.
hintNameNoAddress.message: — the name has no address records on the bridge

hintBridgeEndpoint.description: Taxonomy hint: the bridge endpoint setting may be wrong; $LOC$ names where the setting sits ("below"/"above").
hintBridgeEndpoint.message: — is the bridge endpoint set correctly $LOC$?

hintBridgeUnreadable.description: Taxonomy hint: the extension's settings store rejected the bridge read — the stored bridge endpoint is probably fine, so never route this to the endpoint setting.
hintBridgeUnreadable.message: — the extension's settings could not be read; the bridge endpoint itself is probably fine

hintGrantMissing.message: — the bridge needs host access: open the extension popup and click "$LABEL$".
hintGrantMissing.description: Taxonomy hint: a stored custom bridge lacks its optional host-permission grant, so the bridge fetch dies as a network error; $LABEL$ is the popup's Grant-button label.

hintHealthUnknownProbe.description: Health-check taxonomy hint: the configured bridge does not know genesis.cyberspace.
hintHealthUnknownProbe.message: — the bridge doesn't know genesis.cyberspace: is the endpoint set correctly $LOC$?

hintWireMalformed.description: Taxonomy hint: the bridge answered with a malformed DNS message.
hintWireMalformed.message: — the bridge sent a malformed DNS message

hintWireMalformedHealth.description: Health-check taxonomy hint: malformed DNS message plus endpoint direction.
hintWireMalformedHealth.message: — the bridge sent a malformed DNS message: is the bridge endpoint set correctly $LOC$?

optionsCheckBridgeInvalid.description: Options page: Check-bridge-now fails because the box holds an invalid bridge URL.
optionsCheckBridgeInvalid.message: Enter a valid DoH bridge URL before checking, e.g. http://1.2.3.4/dns-query — $1$

optionsCheckBridgeRunning.description: Options page: live bridge health check is in flight.

optionsCheckBridgeLive.description: Options page: bridge health check succeeded.

optionsCheckBridgeDown.description: Options page: bridge health check failed (taxonomy hint appended after).

optionsCheckBridgeDenied.description: Options page: bridge health check aborted because the optional host-permission grant for the custom bridge's origin was denied (or no prompt could be shown); $BRIDGE$ is the truncated bridge URL. Check stays read-only — nothing was saved.
optionsCheckBridgeDenied.message: Host access for $BRIDGE$ was not granted — the check can't reach the bridge, and nothing was saved. Click Save to request it.

grantAccessLabel.description: Options page grant banner button: requests the optional host-permission grant for a stored custom bridge's origin

optionsCheckNoPrompt.description: Options page: bridge health check's permission pre-flight threw the no-prompt fault — the check's click somehow carried no transient activation, so the browser never showed the grant prompt; nothing was denied, nothing saved; $BRIDGE$ is the truncated bridge URL
optionsCheckNoPrompt.message: The browser never asked for host access for $BRIDGE$ — so nothing was denied and nothing was saved. Click Check again to retry.

optionsCheckGrantFault.description: Options page: bridge health check's permission pre-flight hit a permissions-surface error (contains/request threw); $BRIDGE$ is the truncated bridge URL, $ERR$ is the truncated internal fault — deliberately NOT phrased as a denial, since a throw is never a denial
optionsCheckGrantFault.message: Host access for $BRIDGE$ could not be verified ($ERR$) — the check can't reach the bridge, and nothing was saved. Click Check again to retry.

optionsGrantBanner.description: Options page on-load banner: a stored custom bridge saved before the permission-gating pass lacks its origin grant, so every resolve dies silently; $BRIDGE$ is the truncated bridge URL
optionsGrantBanner.message: Host access for $BRIDGE$ is not granted — this bridge was saved before permission gating, so checks and lookups will fail until you grant it.

optionsGrantOk.message: Host access granted — the stored bridge is live again.
optionsGrantOk.description: Options page: the Grant button's permission request was approved

optionsGrantDenied.message: Host access was not granted — the stored bridge stays, but checks and lookups will keep failing until you grant it.
